title: Ghost Train Sound
description: I have added custom sounds for trains and stations.
body:
# 🚆 Ghost Train Sound (Fabric)

**Ghost Train Sound** adds immersive custom train and station announcement audio to Minecraft! Perfect for roleplay servers, city builds, metro systems, or adventure maps, this mod gives you a full set of train-related voice lines and number calls that can be triggered with simple commands.

Bring your railways to life with realistic platform announcements, service types, and numbered train calls.

***

## 🔊 Features

*   🎙 Custom train and station announcement sounds
*   🔢 Full number set (one to ninety)
*   🚄 Service types like:
    *   Express
    *   Regional
    *   Metro
    *   High Speed
    *   Commuter
    *   Rural
*   🛤 Announcement phrases such as:
    *   “Calling at”
    *   “Service to”
    *   “Platform”
    *   “For the”
    *   “Only”

All sounds are fully usable with Minecraft’s `/playsound` command, giving you total control over when and how they’re played.

***

## 🛠 How to Use

Use the following format:

`/playsound ghost_train_sound: master [@a]`

## Example:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

 /playsound ghost_train_sound:twelve master @a 
 
 /playsound ghost_train_sound:express master @p ~ ~ ~ 0.5 1.2

</details>
